tell: Stores stand on dry ground out of the damp, as near the food as the culture will put them: a communal village keeps its store by the fire, a scattered one by whatever is rotting.
score: 1.0 * (1 - clamp(parcel.slope, 0, 8) / 8) + 2.0 * (1 - field.damp) + 1.5 * (1 - field.flood) - lerp(0.05, 0.3, gene.communal_ratio) * parcel.hearth
